mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier_billing_request (id, doc_no, company, period_type, from_date, to_date, store, supplier_code, supplier_contract, supplier_type, carry_forward_decimal, status, process_status, error_reason, process_date, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{docNo}, #{company,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{periodType}, #{fromDate}, #{toDate}, #{store,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{supplierCode}, #{supplierContract,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{supplierType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{carryForwardDecimal}, #{status}, #{processStatus}, #{errorReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{processDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO supplier_billing_request_detail (id, billing_id, item_code, uom, sales_qty, sales_return_qty, bf_qty, billing_qty, cf_qty, unit_cost, total_cost, total_supplier_qty) VALUES (#{id}, #{billingId}, #{itemCode}, #{uom}, #{salesQty}, #{salesReturnQty}, #{bfQty}, #{billingQty}, #{cfQty}, #{unitCost,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalCost,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalSupplierQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_no, company, period_type, from_date, to_date, store, supplier_code, supplier_contract, supplier_type, carry_forward_decimal, status, process_status, error_reason, process_date, created_by, released_at, created_at, updated_at FROM supplier_billing_request WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT h.id, h.doc_no, h.company, h.period_type, h.from_date, h.to_date, h.store, h.supplier_code, h.supplier_contract, h.supplier_type, h.carry_forward_decimal, h.status, h.process_status, h.error_reason, h.process_date, h.created_by, h.released_at, h.created_at, h.updated_at FROM supplier_billing_request h
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{c.perPage} OFFSET #{c.offset}

SELECT id, billing_id, item_code, uom, sales_qty, sales_return_qty, bf_qty, billing_qty, cf_qty, unit_cost, total_cost, total_supplier_qty FROM supplier_billing_request_detail WHERE billing_id = #{billingId} ORDER BY item_code
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_billing_request SET status = #{status}, released_at = #{releasedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(doc_no FROM 6) AS BIGINT)), 0) FROM supplier_billing_request WHERE doc_no ~ '^SCBR-[0-9]+'
